messages:
Sam: Quick sync — planning version rollforward for next week's cut. Proposing API v0.15.0, runtime v1.8.2, console v0.9.1, python-sdk v0.7.0. Need pins for each repo (api, runtime, console, sdk) and a short changelog head for release notes. Please call out any blockers or required migration notes by EOD PST. cc @Alex @Priya :mag_right:

Alex: Got it. For the API, do we also bump the grpc-client submodule? If so I'll open the PR this afternoon.

Priya: I'll check runtime compatibility flags — there was a hidden toggled behavior with kv-cache TTL that might affect high‑p50 workloads. If it's a risk I'll propose a graceful flag (runtime flag: `--kv-cache-strict=false`).

Maria: Changelog stub added under console/CHANGELOG.md. I put the user-facing bullet points and the internal upgrade note. PTAL: https://git.redwood/console/commit/abc123 :eyes:

Riley: For sdk publish, remind me: do we tag sdk after console or after api? I can take care of the PyPI publish step either way but want to avoid a mismatch in client surface.

Sam: Prefer tagging order: api -> runtime -> console -> sdk. Reason: API surface first, runtime compatibility then console UX, sdk final publish to pick up generated client changes.

Alex: I'll open two PRs: api bump + grpc-client bump. I'll add a CHANGELOG entry `Breaking: header normalization` with migration note.

Priya: Found one unit test failing locally with `kv-cache` TTL changes. I'll target a PR within 2 hours and assign to @Sam for a quick review. Also adding an integration test case to capture p99 latency regression.

deploy-bot: CI report: api main branch build #452 ✅ all checks passed. runtime branch 'bump-v1.8.2' build #78 ❌ failing integration (timeout in `kv_cache_integration_test`).

Maria: I'll coordinate docs review for the console bullet points — assigning to @Riley for release notes phrasing.

Riley: Happy to review docs. Also note: sdk changelog needs an entry about `client.timeout` default change. I'll draft and push.

Sam: Action items summary: 1) @Alex open api + grpc-client PRs; 2) @Priya fix runtime test + open PR; 3) @Maria finalize console changelog and docs PR; 4) @Riley prepare sdk changelog + publish plan; 5) I'll cut the release branch after all PRs are merged and CI is green. Please mark PRs with `release/next-cut` label.

Alex: Will do. ETA PRs by 1700 PST.

Priya: PR open: runtime#342 — fixes test + adds temp feature flag for graceful fallback. Marked for Sam review.

Maria: docs PR: console#218 waiting for Riley wording.

Riley: Drafted sdk changelog and add publish checklist in sdk/RELEASE.md. Will push in ~45m.

Sam: If anyone expects a blocker beyond today's window, call it out now. Otherwise I'll queue the release branch tomorrow morning UTC to hit the Monday maintenance window. :thumbsup:

Alex: Nope, looks clear from my side. :+1:

Priya: Almost clear — will add a short rollback note in the runtime PR in case kv-cache flag causes regressions.

Maria: Docs queued.

deploy-bot: Notification: runtime bump-branch CI fixed after Priya's PR, build #79 ✅.

Sam: Great — thanks all. I'll post final bump confirmation once I create the `release/v0.15.0` branch.

Alex: Thanks — ping me when branch exists, I'll rebase PRs.

Riley: Ping received. I'll hold off publishing sdk until you confirm the branch and tag order.

Sam: Will do. End of thread.
